name: RESTORE_POINT_v1.2.0_RNS_CAMPUS_FULL
description: Full restore point with File Database (db.json) persistence, uncropped notice image viewer, 16:9 ratio support, Nepali 2-4 word slugs, reordered Admin tabs, and expanded website load modal.
features: Permanent File Database (src/data/db.json) with GET/POST /api/campus-data API middleware
Interactive uncropped notice document scan viewer tab with 100% zoom and direct download
Nepali 2-4 word unique Devanagari slugs for Events and Chronicles
Reordered Admin CMS tabs with Notice (default) and Event on top with spacing divider
Expanded Website Load Popup Modal (up to 850px width / 75vh height)
CKEditor integration for Events, Notices, Chronicles, Vision, Mission & Goals
Custom confirm delete modal for Admin deletions
